plan.title: Create Auction eRFX from Asset PR

steps.note: Enable multi-stage eRFX project creation for the tenant.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation so publishing is possible.
Verify that the PR-populated product, variant, and requested quantity cells are locked.
Add the two vendors named in the case to the event.
Commit the requested Start now schedule with a 30-minute duration.
Publish the completed PR-based Auction eRFX project.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Verify that Recreate Order is greyed out for an event created from a PR.
Verify that the In Progress PR table contains at least one entry after publishing.
